proof_decision.trust_question: Do one-shot review and stack-restack operations remain exact-head, idempotent, fail-closed, and auditable across stale races and bounded publication failures?
proof_decision.narrowest_evidence: The existing review-loop suite plus real temporary Git remotes cover stopped-watcher launch, duplicate reuse, stale-head races, patch/ancestry preservation, exact leases, preflight isolation, successful publication, and failed publication receipts.
proof_decision.prune_or_replacement_condition: Replace only when a narrower end-to-end review transport and remote-stack harness proves the same exact-head request, CAS publication, patch preservation, and partial-write boundaries.
proof_decision.residual_risk: The external reviewer can complete without posting a marker, which is intentionally retained as an idempotent awaiting-result receipt. Multi-branch publication is not atomic, so every successful bounded write is recorded for recovery.
